messages:
sec-alert-bot: New advisory posted: CVE-2026-4732 affecting cryptography (python) <=39.2.1 — deserialization RCE. CVSS 9.8, EPSS 0.71, PoC published. Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-4732

emily: :eyes: I think our job-runner and data-processor images pin cryptography==39.2.1 in requirements.txt. Raising P1?

raj: Confirmed. quick grep shows `services/worker/requirements.txt: cryptography==39.2.1`. We don't directly ship KMS libs, but aws-encryption-sdk calls into cryptography. Need to check if key material could be exposed via an exploited process.

morgan: If there's a PoC and CVSS ~9.8, treat as P0 for public-facing runners. I'll take coordination unless someone else volunteers.

cheng: I'll spin a sandbox and try the PoC now. If it works, assume full arbitrary code exec in the container and escalate. Chore list: repro, capture network calls, check for KMS use.

sarah: Also flagging audit logging — if exploited, attacker may invoke KMS Decrypt. We should immediately check CloudTrail for anomalous decrypt calls and bump retention around the window. Paging infra oncall.

emily: Quick remediation plan: 1) bump cryptography to 40.0.0 (if released) 2) build new images 3) canary to staging 4) rollout to prod with canary/monitoring. Quick commands: ```pip install 'cryptography>=40.0.0' && docker build -t infra/worker:canary .```

raj: We also maintain pinned wheels in our internal artifacts repo (artifacts.redwood). We'll need to publish the updated wheel there before images can be built in CI.

morgan: Opening INFSEC ticket and scheduling rollout. Proposed timeline: staging canary in 1h, prod full rollout in 6h if clean. If PoC confirmed and exploit observed in the wild, accelerate to hotpatch immediate deploy and container image block for old tags.

cheng: Preliminary quickscore: CVSS 9.8, EPSS 0.71, PoC present -> exploitability = HIGH. Recommendation: immediate patch + registry block + forensics window.

sarah: RBAC mitigation: propose temporary KMS policy denying Decrypt for the worker role for 24h to reduce blast radius while we patch. This will likely break some batch decrypt jobs — need owners to sign off.

emily: Fine with RBAC restriction as long as owners can request an emergency allow if it breaks critical jobs. Add this to the INFSEC ticket.

raj: Also recommending: add alert rule for >5 KMS Decrypt events/min from a single principal and increase CloudTrail retention for 30 days in the account scoped to the workers' role.

morgan: Assigned. sec-alert-bot, please create an incident channel and link INFSEC-9876. Everyone, react with :thumbsup: if you can pick up tasks or with :eyes: if you're only observing.

sec-alert-bot: Created #inc-1964321123-cryptography-rce and INFSEC-9876. Remediation checklist and quickscore attached to ticket.
